source.title: Genadi and Morozov predict Ermes vs Jerry and Vitaly vs Revaz supermatches
source.description:
Genadi and Morozov have talked about the upcoming Jerry vs Ermes supermatch, and Morozov thinks that Ermes will win if he doesn't lose the center. Genadi believes that Ermes will win the first 2 rounds, but after that, if his endurance is not high enough, Jerry could win the last 3 rounds.

About the upcoming Vitaly vs Revaz supermatch, Genadi believes that Revaz will beat Vitaly. Morozov thinks Vitaly will win because he will be very unconfortable for Revaz.
